# runpod_data_center (Data Source)

A single data center looked up by identifier.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_data_center" "eu_ro_1" {
  id = "EU-RO-1"
}

output "network_volume_types" {
  description = "Storage tiers the data center offers."
  value       = data.runpod_data_center.eu_ro_1.network_volume_types
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Data center identifier, e.g. "EU-RO-1".

### Read-Only

- `compliance` (List of String) Compliance certifications held by the data center.
- `global_network` (Boolean) Whether global networking is available.
- `name` (String) Human-readable data center name.
- `network_volume_types` (List of String) Network volume storage tiers offered.
- `region` (String) Geographic region.
